LanguageData.Mission1_Discovery.label: What is that?
LanguageData.Mission1_Discovery.description: One of our pawns has spotted an unusual object in the sky. On the Rim it is nothing special to see meteoroids or space debris fly by at the night sky, or even have one land in front of your doorstep, but this one is different. At first it seemed like another toxic ship part, but the colorful trail is unlike anything we have seen so far. It's obviously more than just another space rock and could use some more observation, but how...?
